notes:
Movies and Shows now sort large catalogues in the background, removing the long pauses measured when those pages opened and each time their featured banner moved on.

On Movies and Shows, posters and banners are tagged LIVE or COMING UP, ON DEMAND, or both. Library posters on Home are tagged ON DEMAND; Home's live cards don't check for on-demand copies yet.

In Ways to watch, tap anywhere on a row to pick it.

A show's Play button starts at season 1 rather than its specials, unless you're partway through a special. Specials are listed after the seasons.
